# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and student  <sub>[v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Shirley  <sub>[v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne has gray eyes that are compared to a morning sky and bold red hair, which she considers auburn. She possesses a very nice nose.

_Sources: [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003), [v3 c31 P4](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0004), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Anne is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious individual with a blithe, irresistible laugh. Possessing a natural genius for friendship, she values comradeship and views intellectual discussions with deep appreciation. Though prone to romanticism, she maintains a sense of humor and warmth that endears her to others.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c1 P8](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0008)_

## History

Anne attended Queen's Academy in a Second Year course alongside her schoolmates, striving hard for top honors like the Avery scholarship and engaging in intense academic competition with Gilbert Blythe. After her schooling, she spent time as a country schoolteacher at Valley Road, where she boarded at 'Wayside' with Miss Janet Sweet, and later taught for three years in Summerside. Over time, her long-standing rivalry with Gilbert turned into deep affection, leading to their eventual engagement to marry. Prior to her marriage, she completed her teaching duties and returned to Green Gables to prepare for her future life with Gilbert.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005)_
